## Scope check

This project optimises for a specific thing: a teacher on one machine, a
classroom on the local network, no cloud and no external services. Requests that
need a hosted service, a third-party API at runtime, or a multi-tenant deployment
are unlikely to be accepted — the runtime has almost no dependencies on purpose,
and the sandbox is not built for strangers (see `docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md`).

That is not a reason not to ask. It is a reason to describe the classroom
problem precisely.
